about_the_game:
Death is always among us... Indeed, the Deaths! They know how to blend in among humans to be undercover and able to do their “job” in the best possible way. Jacmena is a girl gifted with the beyond vision and she's able to discover their secret identity, and other realities hidden from us. Her life turns unexpectedly when she meets the graveyard's old caretaker, Zvan: an unusual friendship that will lead her to discover things about herself she thought unthinkable.

We get to know Jacmena as an enigma: why can she see the Deaths? Why does she try to attract their attention? Why does she have nowhere to go? Luckily for her, Zvan does not judge and sees only a human being in distress.... And a possible assistant!

A short but exciting point-and-click that draws its inspiration directly from the traditions and folklore of Romagna, a land in central Italy that has so much to tell.

content_descriptors.notes: This videogame faces death in a light and ironic context; however the story is touching at some point. We understand it can hit people differently, basing on their personal experience. We do not recommend playing it if you experienced a loss recently or if you're feeling uncomfortable with the concept of death in general

short_description: “Tin bòta, Jacmena!” A strange little girl always out of place and with a special power befriends the old keeper of a cemetery. Experience the story of Jacmena and Zvan in this hand drawn point-and-click adventure that draws inspiration from the legends and traditions of Romagna folklore.
supported_languages: Italian, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain
